request.query: For a finitely supported function P with coefficients in a type having only zero, pulling P back along an injective coordinate insertion f has coefficient at d equal to P (f d)

items.informal_name: Evaluation of Embedded Finite Support Function at Image Point
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Zero M] (f : α ↪ β) (v : α →₀ M) (a : α),
  (Finsupp.embDomain f v) (f a) = v a
items.informal_description: For an injective function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ and a finite support function $ v : \alpha \to_0 M $, evaluating the embedded function $ \text{embDomain}(f, v) $ at $ f(a) $ yields $ v(a) $. Formally, $ (\text{embDomain}\, f\, v)(f(a)) = v(a) $ for all $ a : \alpha $.

items.informal_name: Embedding of finite support functions via domain mapping
items.type: {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → {M : Type u_4} → [inst : Zero M] → (α ↪ β) → (α →₀ M) → β →₀ M
items.informal_description: Given an injective function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ and a finite support function $ v : \alpha \to_0 M $, this constructs a finite support function $ \beta \to_0 M $ whose support is the image of $ v $'s support under $ f $. For each $ a_2 \in \beta $, the value is $ v(a_1) $ where $ a_1 $ is the unique pre-image of $ a_2 $ under $ f $ (if it exists in $ v $'s support), otherwise zero. The injectivity of $ f $ ensures the image support remains finite and values are well-defined.

items.informal_name: Domain Mapping for Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] {f : α → β},
  Function.Injective f → ∀ (x : α →₀ M) (a : α), (Finsupp.mapDomain f x) (f a) = x a
items.informal_description: Given a function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ and a finite support function $ x : \alpha \to_0 M $, this constructs a finite support function $ \beta \to_0 M $ by summing the values of $ x $ over all pre-images of each $ b \in \beta $ under $ f $. Specifically, for each $ b \in \beta $, the resulting function evaluates to $ \sum_{a \in f^{-1}(b)} x(a) $, with finite support inherited from $ x $.

items.informal_name: ComapDomain Application Equality for Dependent Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {β : ι → Type v} {κ : Type u_1} [inst : (i : ι) → Zero (β i)] (h : κ → ι) (hh : Function.Injective h)
  (f : Π₀ (i : ι), β i) (k : κ), (DFinsupp.comapDomain h hh f) k = f (h k)
items.informal_description: Let $ h : \kappa \to \iota $ be an injective function, and let $ f $ be a dependent finite support function from $ \iota $ to a family of types $ \beta(i) $ (each equipped with a zero element). For any $ k \in \kappa $, the value of the function obtained by reindexing $ f $ via $ h $ at $ k $ is equal to $ f(h(k)) $. In symbols, $ (\text{comapDomain}(h, f))(k) = f(h(k)) $.

items.informal_name: Pullback of a dependent function with finite support along an injective function
items.type:
{ι : Type u} →
  {β : ι → Type v} →
    {κ : Type u_1} →
      [inst : (i : ι) → Zero (β i)] → (h : κ → ι) → Function.Injective h → (Π₀ (i : ι), β i) → Π₀ (k : κ), β (h k)
items.informal_description: Let $\iota$ and $\kappa$ be types, and let $\beta$ be a family of types indexed by $\iota$, where each type $\beta(i)$ has a zero element. Given an injective function $h : \kappa \to \iota$ and a dependent function with finite support $f : \Pi_0(i:\iota), \beta(i)$, `DFinsupp.comapDomain` constructs a new dependent function with finite support over the domain $\kappa$. This new function is defined as the pre-composition $f \circ h$, which maps an element $k \in \kappa$ to $f(h(k)) \in \beta(h(k))$. The injectivity of $h$ is required to ensure that the resulting function also has finite support.

items.informal_name: Embedding of Finite Support Functions via Domain Mapping
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Zero M] (f : α ↪ β) (v : α →₀ M) (b : β),
  (Finsupp.embDomain f v) b = if h : ∃ a, f a = b then v h.choose else 0
items.informal_description: Given an injective function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ and a finite support function $ v : \alpha \to_0 M $, the function $ \mathrm{embDomain}\, f\, v $ is a finite support function $ \beta \to_0 M $ defined by $ (\mathrm{embDomain}\, f\, v)(b) = v(a) $ if there exists $ a \in \alpha $ with $ f(a) = b $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. The injectivity of $ f $ ensures the support of $ \mathrm{embDomain}\, f\, v $ is finite and values are well-defined.
